rules: Every WebUI route adapts by width plus height/width ratio, not device name or width alone.
Portrait layouts show one primary surface at a time.
Home rows remain one-line in portrait.
Settings, Timer, Tools, Search, and New surfaces use portrait-safe pages or sheets with sticky close/back controls.
Long code/schema/log/prose blocks scroll or wrap internally without widening the document.
Layout changes preserve selected session, draft input, route, scroll intent, pending submit, and owner query state.
Layout state must not create fallback owner truth.

routes.label: Mobile WebUI Root
routes.truth_source: browser route state over ADP projections

routes.label: Home / 会话首页
routes.owns: session navigation dashboard and session CRUD management
forbidden: expanded Worker child lists by default

routes.label: SessionDetail(session_id) / 单会话
routes.owns: one selected session transcript and scoped status
routes.truth_source: QuerySessionTurns pinned to session_id plus scoped TaskBoard/AgentBoard

dispatch_wait_model.context_boundary: Worker transcripts stay isolated from the Master transcript until TaskBoard/TaskHistory/EventInbox returns typed child result truth.
dispatch_wait_model.parent_notifications: success, failure, blocked, and interrupted child outcomes are rigid parent-visible owner notifications, not browser guesses.
dispatch_wait_model.waiting_state: selected Master sessions may wait while child tasks or source timers can wake lifecycle, and the composer remains available for user input.
dispatch_wait_model.timer_boundary: periodic waiting checks belong to runtime Timer/TaskBoard owner truth; WebUI refreshes projections but never synthesizes timers.

historical_worker_failure_projection.truth_source: ordered QuerySessionTurns terminal statuses plus TaskBoard closed status for the projected worker_session_id
historical_worker_failure_projection.recovered_condition: older Failed followed by later Success while task status is closed
historical_worker_failure_projection.normal_projection: data-recovery-state=historical_failure_recovered and recovery summary without duplicate raw provider error
historical_worker_failure_projection.debug_projection: original failed turn and provider error remain inspectable

routes.label: CurrentSessionAgentSheet
routes.owns: selected-session child task and Worker navigation presentation
routes.truth_source: TaskBoard and AgentBoard scoped by parent_session_id / worker_session_id

mutual_exclusion.rule: Home running/history dashboard and selected transcript primary body cannot be visible at the same time on phone.

needs_user: ToolPending/user choice without open lifecycle owner
stale: active-looking summary obsoleted by later terminal turn or closed owner projection

acceptance_gates: Home route body contains compact dashboard header plus running/history rows only.
Home history rows are grouped only as 今天, 过去一周, and 所有更早的.
Home renders exactly one visible row per session; rows do not wrap into multi-line cards.
Every route adapts to portrait by viewport width plus height/width ratio and keeps no document-level horizontal overflow.
Home supports multi-select and owner-backed delete/remove controls without browser-local session truth.
Rename controls appear only in SessionDetail for the current selected session.
SessionDetail route hides Home running/history sections.
SessionDetail Header Worker rail shows current child Worker status plus owner-timestamp duration and expands details on row click.
Waiting-user sessions are not classified as running.
ToolsRegistry has no document-level horizontal overflow on phone.
All visible route/status decisions are backed by owner projections.

Closed Worker tasks with an older Failed turn followed by a later Success mark only the older cycle historical_failure_recovered; normal mode suppresses duplicate raw provider errors and debug mode retains original failure truth.
